response.rationale: I think these probably name the same capability. Both rest on the same class, ClubBookingRepository (node 440da90bcde7901a), and both describe clubs making bookings. A ("Club rink booking") is the business community made up of ClubBookingService and ClubBookingRepository. B ("Club group booking") is shown only through that same repository, inside the persistence component. "Rink" and "group" look like two names for one thing: a club booking rink time for its members. Nothing in B points to a separate group-booking process. One thing lowers my confidence: B's persistence component also holds unrelated classes (DropTextClient, PuckPayClient, BookingRepository, SessionRepository). So B's scope is broader and more technical, and the two may not match exactly in scope.
